# Account Reporting Groups API routes

Custom report groupings that aggregate GL accounts for balance sheet and income statement presentations. Supports a tree of named groups, each scoped to one report type, with an ordered member list of GL account IDs.

## Endpoints

| Method + path | Handler | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/accounting/account-reporting-groups` | `account-reporting-groups.ts` | List all active groups with members for the company. |
| `POST /api/accounting/account-reporting-groups` | `account-reporting-groups.ts` | Create a new group. Body: `{ name, report_type, display_order? }`. |
| `PATCH /api/accounting/account-reporting-groups?id=` | `account-reporting-groups.ts` | Partial update — name, report_type, or display_order. Pass `id` as query param. |
| `DELETE /api/accounting/account-reporting-groups?id=` | `account-reporting-groups.ts` | Soft-delete (sets `is_active = false`). Pass `id` as query param. |
| `GET /api/accounting/account-reporting-groups/[id]/members` | `[id]/members.ts` | List GL account members for a group. Response: `{ items, count }`. |
| `POST /api/accounting/account-reporting-groups/[id]/members` | `[id]/members.ts` | Replace all members for a group. Body: `{ gl_account_ids: string[] }`. Full replace, not append. |

## Auth

`withAuth(withErrorHandler(withCsrf(handler)))` on the top-level CRUD route. Sub-resource `[id]/members.ts` uses `withAuth(withErrorHandler(handler))` — no CSRF wrapper (read + replace via same file, both GETs and POSTs go through the same auth chain without explicit CSRF on that file).

## Response contract

All routes return `apiResponse.success(res, data)`. PATCH returns the updated row; DELETE returns `{ id }`. Group creation uses `apiResponse.success(res, group, 'Group created', 201)`. Errors: `.badRequest` for validation (duplicate name → caught from DB unique violation), `.notFound` if group not found.

## Business rules / gotchas

- `report_type` must be one of `balance_sheet | income_statement | both` — validated server-side.
- Member POST is a **full replace** — the service deletes existing rows then inserts the new list; all `gl_account_ids` must be non-empty strings.
- `PATCH` and `DELETE` take `id` as a **query parameter** on the base path, not as a path segment — e.g. `PATCH /account-reporting-groups?id=<uuid>`.
- Delegates to `services/reports/accountReportingGroupsService.ts`.
